# Charge Tanks

Charge Tanks is a technical battery education site focused on voltage, capacity, OCV, NP ratio, lithium inventory, and aging through the two-tank analogy.

Preferred starting pages:
- https://chargetanks.com/ - Site overview and navigation hub.
- https://chargetanks.com/blog/ - Index of battery articles.
- https://chargetanks.com/blog/two-tank-battery-model/ - Foundational article explaining the two-tank battery model, voltage, capacity, NP ratio, aging, and dQ/dV.
- https://chargetanks.com/tools/ - Interactive battery tools that complement the written explanations.

Primary author:
- Lars von Kolzenberg - https://www.linkedin.com/in/lars-von-kolzenberg/
